confirm.deleteDescription: {{name}} will be removed. This action can be undone by an admin.

absence.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

create.title: Add staff member
create.canSignInHint: Creates an account with a temporary password.
create.emailRequiredForAccess: An email is needed to sign in.
create.emailTaken: This email is already used by someone in this clinic.
create.failed: Could not add the staff member.
create.successMessage: {{name}} can now sign in with this email and temporary password:
create.tempPasswordWarning: This password will not be shown again. It must be changed at first sign-in.

access.title: App access
access.noAccess: This person can't sign in yet.
access.resetBody: {{name}} gets a new temporary password and has to change it at the next sign-in.
access.turnOffBody: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in. The profile and its history stay.
access.selfHint: This is you. Change your own account in Profile & Settings.
access.failed: Could not change access. Please try again.

errors.self: You can't change your own access here. Use Profile & Settings for your own account.
errors.lastOwner: A clinic must keep at least one active owner.
errors.ownerOnly: Only a clinic owner can change another owner.

access.roleBody: {{name}} becomes {{role}}. What they can see and do changes at their next sign-in.
access.roleOwnerBody: {{name}} becomes Clinic owner and gets full control of the clinic: staff and sign-in access, finance and settings.

status.deactivateBody: They can no longer be booked or sign in. Past appointments keep their name, and you can reactivate them later.
status.reactivated: {{name}} is active again. Sign-in stays off until you turn it back on.
status.upcoming_one: {{name}} has {{count}} upcoming appointment. Cancel or move it first.
status.upcoming_other: {{name}} has {{count}} upcoming appointments. Cancel or move them first.
status.hasHistory: {{name}} has appointments, so the profile can't be deleted. Deactivate it instead.

edit.title: Edit — {{name}}
edit.emailLocked: This is the person's sign-in email, so it can't be changed here.
edit.removeBody: {{name}} will be removed. Only possible for a profile with no appointments — otherwise deactivate it.
